schema.description: schema for index of machine-readable issuer JSON URLs

description:
Please find the current machine‑readable data files for our health‑coverage offerings below. The latest formulary definitions are published at https://example.com/formulary/planA.json and https://example.com/formulary/planB.json.

The complete set of plan details can be retrieved from the following URLs: https://example.com/plans/planA.json, https://example.com/plans/planB.json, and https://example.com/plans/planC.json. Provider information is available at https://example.com/providers/provider1.json, https://example.com/providers/provider2.json, and https://example.com/providers/provider3.json.
